description: This source file contains functions related to managing plugin runtime overlay, including creating symbolic links, copying specific files, wrapping modules, and staging plugin runtime overlays. It is part of a build or deployment process for plugins in a larger project.

methods.name: symlinkType
methods.description: Determines the symlink type based on the current platform ('junction' for Windows, 'dir' for others).

methods.name: relativeSymlinkTarget
methods.description: Calculates a relative path from the target directory to the source path, used for creating relative symlinks.

methods.name: ensureSymlink
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link at the target location pointing to the target value, handling existing links or files appropriately.

methods.name: symlinkPath
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link from source to target path using the appropriate type.

methods.name: shouldWrapRuntimeJsFile
methods.description: Checks if the source path points to a JavaScript file that needs to be wrapped.

methods.name: shouldCopyRuntimeFile
methods.description: Determines if a file should be copied based on its filename (e.g., package.json, plugin.json).

methods.name: writeRuntimeModuleWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a JavaScript module by writing an export wrapper around the source file into the target file.

methods.name: stagePluginRuntimeOverlay
methods.description: Recursively overlays plugin files from source directory to target directory, handling wrapping, copying, and symlinks.

methods.name: linkPluginNodeModules
methods.description: Creates symlinks for node_modules directories from the plugin source to the runtime directory.

methods.name: stageBundledPluginRuntime
methods.description: Main exported function that stages the plugin runtime by processing extension directories and creating overlays.
